## Join WISE for our June Paris meetup, hosted at 42 !

Join a vibrant community of women at the forefront of AI ethics and safety. 

**Whether you're a professional seeking to expand your network of brilliant women around the world, a newcomer exploring a career transition, or simply interested in connecting with local women passionate about responsible AI – this meetup is for you! We aim to create the space for you to have meaningful conversations and create long-lasting connections.**

​The meetup will take place at the **42 campus in Paris**. Due to limited space, we can only accept up to 30 external participants. Note that all registrants must be approved in order to attend. To maximize your chances of being approved, please include as much information (LinkedIn, position/role, organization) as possible.

​This meetup will also feature **a special guest, Mia Shah-Dand, Founder of Women in AI Ethics™ (WAIE)**. Mia will briefly present her work on WAIE, upcoming events and initiatives, and ways to get involved in the WAIE community.

### What's on the agenda ?

- ​19:00-19:30 Welcome & mingling: Light refreshments and quick introductions
- 19:30-20:00 Micro Talks: Hear from our hosts at 42AI and our special guest Mia Shah-Dand from WAIE
- 20:00-21:00 Close out the evening with more time for conversations & connections

### About the Organizer 
​
Women in Safety and Ethics (WISE) is a global association dedicated to empowering and connecting women pursuing safe and ethical AI advancement across academia, civil society, and industry. To learn more about WISE, please visit wiseai.community and sign up for updates!

### ​About the Host

**​42AI** is a student association at the internationally renowned programming school 42 whose purpose is to encourage and promote the learning of AI, as well as to build and animate a network of enthusiasts around these issues. They create educational content and organize events for students throughout the year.

### About Women in AI Ethics™

​Since 2018, **Women in AI Ethics™ (WAIE)** has elevated the voices of experts from multidisciplinary backgrounds and showcased the role of diverse perspectives in responsible design and development of AI models and systems. WAIE publishes “100 Brilliant Women in AI Ethics™” list annually, offers free AI literacy classes at public libraries, and hosts expert talks on the most urgent issues in responsible AI as part of its mission to make this space more diverse, ethical, and inclusive.


The [42AI](https://42-ai.github.io) team 🚀
